line:castle:beginning:0: The two friends see a big castle.
line:castle:beginning:2: The gate opens. Come in, come in!
line:castle:ending-1-1:0: They peek under the big throne.
line:castle:ending-1-1:1: A sleepy cat naps on the crown!
line:castle:ending-1-1:2: Purr! The cat shares the crown.
line:castle:ending-1-2:0: Up, up, up the twisty stairs!
line:castle:ending-1-2:1: The crown twinkles by the window!
line:castle:ending-1-2:2: Hooray! They wave from the top!
line:castle:ending-1-3:0: The little mouse squeaks. Follow me!
line:castle:ending-1-3:1: It hops into a tiny hole.
line:castle:ending-1-3:2: The crown! The mouse kept it safe.
line:castle:ending-2-1:0: They bring a big soft tissue.
line:castle:ending-2-1:2: Thank you, friends! No more sneezes.
line:castle:ending-2-2:0: They sing a soft sleepy song.
line:castle:ending-2-2:1: The baby dragon yawns and yawns.
line:castle:ending-2-3:0: The dragon puffs happy smoke rings.
line:castle:ending-2-3:1: They hop through the big rings!
line:castle:ending-3-1:0: Boom! Boom! They play the drum!
line:castle:ending-3-2:0: They do a silly wiggle dance.
line:castle:ending-3-3:1: Tap, tap! Toot, toot! Wake up!
line:castle:ending-3-3:2: The band plays a happy song!
line:castle:middle-1:0: Oh no! The royal crown is lost!
line:castle:middle-1:1: They look up. They look down.
line:castle:middle-1:2: Silly castle! Who hid the crown?
line:castle:middle-2:0: A baby dragon! Do not be scared.
line:castle:middle-2:1: Ah... ah... ACHOO! What a sneeze!
line:castle:middle-2:2: Puff! Smoke rings float up, up!
line:castle:middle-3:0: Music! The royal ball is starting!
line:castle:middle-3:1: But oh no! The music stops.
line:castle:middle-3:2: The royal band is fast asleep!
line:forest:beginning:0: The two friends find an old map.
line:forest:beginning:1: Oh no! It is upside down!
line:forest:beginning:2: They turn it round and round.
line:forest:ending-1-1:0: They dig and dig by the log.
line:forest:ending-1-2:0: They jump in the muddy puddles!
line:forest:ending-1-2:2: Muddy friends laugh all the way home.
line:forest:ending-1-3:0: Up, up, up the big tree!
line:forest:ending-1-3:1: They can see the whole forest!
line:forest:ending-1-3:2: They wave to the birds. Hello!
line:forest:ending-2-1:0: They make a nest of soft moss.
line:forest:ending-2-1:1: The little bird hops inside. So cozy!
line:forest:ending-2-1:2: Peep, peep! That means thank you!
line:forest:ending-2-2:1: La, la, la! Tweet, tweet, tweet!
line:forest:ending-2-2:2: Mama bird swoops down. Tweet, tweet!
line:forest:ending-2-3:0: They share a big brown nut.
line:forest:ending-2-3:1: A cheeky squirrel grabs it! Hey!
line:forest:ending-2-3:2: They all laugh and share the nut.
line:forest:ending-3-1:0: Down, down, down the secret steps.
line:forest:ending-3-1:1: Surprise! A party under the tree!
line:forest:ending-3-1:2: They dance until the moon comes up.
line:forest:ending-3-2:0: They peek in the little den.
line:forest:ending-3-2:1: A fox cub is fast asleep.
line:forest:ending-3-3:0: Blink! Blink! Ten little glow bugs!
line:forest:ending-3-3:1: The bugs light up the dark path.
line:forest:ending-3-3:2: They twinkle like tiny stars. Wow!
line:forest:middle-1:0: They follow the map... the wrong way!
line:forest:middle-1:1: They march past a big log.
line:forest:middle-1:2: Splish, splash! Look at the mud!
line:forest:middle-2:1: It can not find its nest.
line:forest:middle-2:2: Do not be sad. We can help!
line:forest:middle-3:0: A tiny door in the tree!
line:forest:middle-3:1: Knock, knock! Who is in there?
line:outer-space:beginning:1: The little rocket zooms up, up!
line:outer-space:beginning:2: Wow! The moon is so close!
line:outer-space:ending-1-1:0: They peek into the deep crater.
line:outer-space:ending-1-1:1: Hello! Hello! The echo says hello!
line:outer-space:ending-1-1:2: They giggle with the echo. Hello!
line:outer-space:ending-1-2:0: They plant a little happy flag.
line:outer-space:ending-1-2:1: The flag has a big smile.
line:outer-space:ending-1-2:2: Wave, flag, wave at the stars!
line:outer-space:ending-1-3:1: Boing! They fly up to the stars!
line:outer-space:ending-1-3:2: What a jump! Wow, wow, wow!
line:outer-space:ending-2-1:1: The star zooms back to the sky!
line:outer-space:ending-2-1:2: It twinkles. That means thank you!
line:outer-space:ending-2-2:0: Look, little star! That is our home.
line:outer-space:ending-2-2:1: It is blue and green and small.
line:outer-space:ending-2-2:2: The star smiles a twinkle smile.
line:outer-space:ending-2-3:2: The happy star glows so bright!
line:outer-space:ending-3-1:0: They share a yummy space snack.
line:outer-space:ending-3-1:2: Yum! The moon friend loves it!
line:outer-space:ending-3-2:1: Where is the moon friend? Peek!
line:outer-space:ending-3-2:2: Found you! What a fun game!
line:outer-space:ending-3-3:0: They have a picnic on the moon.
line:outer-space:ending-3-3:1: The stars twinkle like tiny lights.
line:outer-space:ending-3-3:2: Good night, moon. Good night, stars.
line:outer-space:middle-1:0: Boing! Boing! Moon jumps are big!
line:outer-space:middle-1:1: They bounce over a moon rock.
line:outer-space:middle-2:0: A little star falls down. Whee!
line:outer-space:middle-2:1: It lands in the soft moon dust.
line:outer-space:middle-2:2: Blink, blink! The star is shy.
line:outer-space:middle-3:2: A green moon friend peeks out!
